goal: Scale the proven native multi-ECS lifecycle through exact real 500-node, 1000-node, and 2000-node runs without weakening safety, evidence quality, or cleanup.

criteria.statement: Exact scale requests through 2000 compile without downscaling, while execution above 200 remains dry-run or explicitly guarded until real distributed execution is implemented.
A real native multi-ECS run requests and independently observes exactly 500 healthy Valkey nodes.
A real native multi-ECS run requests and independently observes exactly 1000 healthy Valkey nodes.
A real native multi-ECS run requests and independently observes exactly 2000 healthy Valkey nodes.
Telemetry, command logs, process journals, and evidence transfer remain complete, bounded, and attributable at every required scale.
Fault containment, recovery, restart, teardown, and deterministic cleanup remain bounded and ownership-safe at every required scale.
Validated reports compare every admitted scale with the 200-node baseline and the immediately preceding admitted scale.
